import "fmt"

func main() {
  num := 3

  switch num {
    case 1:
      fmt.Println("One")
    case 2:

resolved.title: switch 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]switch[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In other programming languages, such as C++ or Java, each case needs to have a [b]break[/b] statement, in order to stop the execution of the [b]switch[/b] statement.

In Go, the [b]break[/b] statement is not needed, as the [b]switch[/b] cases evaluate from top to bottom, stopping when a case succeeds.  

[note]Similar to [b]if[/b] statements, [b]switch[/b] can also have a short variable declaration before the conditional expression.[/note]

content.text:
在其他编程语言中，如C++或Java，每个case都需要有一个**break**语句，以停止**switch**语句的执行。

在Go中，不需要**break**语句，因为**switch**从上到下判断某个case是否执行，当一个case执行后则停止，自动退出。
content.text_html:
In other programming languages, such as C++ or Java, each case needs to have a break statement, in order to stop the execution of the switch statement.

In Go, the break statement is not needed, as the switch cases evaluate from top to bottom, stopping when a case succeeds.

在其他编程语言中，如C++或Java，每个案例都需要有一个break语句，以便停止switch语句的执行。

在Go中，不需要break语句，因为switch案例从上到下评估，当一个案例成功时就停止。

content.text: 与**if**语句类似，**switch**在条件表达式之前也可以有一个短变量声明。
content.text_html:
Similar to if statements, switch can also have a short variable declaration before the conditional expression.

与if语句类似，switch在条件表达式之前也可以有一个简短的变量声明。

resolved.title: 声音频率类别
resolved.problem_statement_md:
人耳可以听到频率在**20**至**20,000**赫兹，称为**可听**频率。

低于20赫兹的称为**中音**，而高于20,000赫兹的称为**超声波**。

编写一个程序，输入声音频率，并输出相应的类别:
- [20,  20,000] :**可听**
- 小于20 : **中音**
- 大于20,000: **超声波**

如果给定的输入是负数，程序应该输出 "错误输入"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Sound Frequencies[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The human ear can hear sounds with frequencies in the range of [b]20 Hz[/b] to [b]20,000 Hz[/b].
This is called the [b]Audible[/b] frequency.
Anything below 20 Hz is called [b]Infrasound[/b], while anything above 20,000 Hz is called [b]Ultrasound[/b].

You need to make a program that takes a sound frequency as input and outputs the corresponding category. 

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
1800

[b]Sample Output: [/b]
Audible

[note]In case the given input is negative, your program should output "[b]Wrong Input[/b]".[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var f int
	fmt.Scanln(&f)
	switch {
	case f < 0:
		fmt.Println("错误输入")
	case f < 20:
		fmt.Println("中音")
	case f > 20000:
		fmt.Println("超声波")
	default:
		fmt.Println("可听")
	}
}
